scope: role-aware precision figure installed in the manuscript (label fig:paradigms)
scientific_status: recorded states and recorded labels illustrate the three representations; no model prediction and no baseline output is shown

frames.origin: 640 px Blender renders of the recorded states, extracted unchanged from the frames embedded in archive/three_column_pipeline/paradigms.svg; render provenance in that folder's source.json

labels.projection_check: projected patch points and +400 ms flow ends match the stored pixel labels to 1e-6 px
labels.target_outlines: traced automatically from the rendered target pixels, with the projected target origin used as a seed

panels.a: recorded future frames at +50, +200, +400 ms in colour (front: +400 ms); nothing overlaid
panels.b: current frame as grey context with the target in colour; target silhouette at +400 ms, origin path with 50 ms ticks, pose axes now and at +400 ms
panels.c: same context; all 196 patch-centre samples with their recorded +400 ms displacement (arrows where it exceeds 2 mm, dots otherwise) plus the target overlay of b

display_processing: context frames desaturated and lifted; the target keeps its rendered colour inside its traced silhouette
enlarged region is a Lanczos upsample of the 640 px render (x = 130..500, y = 239.5..428)
target silhouettes are traced from the renders of frames 29 and 37; pose axes are 28 mm long
flow and target motion are drawn at true scale, with no display exaggeration

marks.a_cross: target metric pose stays implicit (introduction, paragraph 2)
marks.a_check: whole scene forecast in every frame
marks.c_checks: coarse whole-scene sparse 3D flow and precise target SE(3) (method, Sec. 3.3)

deployment: both forecasts supervise training and are skipped at inference (stated in the caption only)
